item.title: Salsa Thursdays at Time Out Market — Thu Aug 20, 7:00 PM — Time Out Market New York
item.description:
Join us for one of NYC’s best free salsa nights and turn your Thursday into a dance-floor celebration.
Get your salsa on every Thursday night at Time Out Market New York! Head up to the fifth floor for an electrifying evening of rhythm, movement, and Latin vibes. Whether you’re a total beginner or a seasoned dancer, this is your weekly excuse to move, sweat, and smile. Starting at 7:30 PM, renowned instructor Marlene Veras will guide you through the steps, breaking down the fundamentals so you feel confident on the dance floor. The night is powered by infectious beats from DJ Ray Suave, with live percussion by Jessica La Timbalera, setting the stage for a high-energy salsa experience. After the lesson, the floor opens up for a full-on salsa dance party until 10 PM. Bring a partner or come solo—everyone’s welcome.

item.title: Protecting Your Family Treasures — Mon Aug 24, 2:00 PM — Agincourt
item.description:
Many of us have treasured items - such as books, photographs, letters, and documents - that reflect our family histories and hold deep personal significance. Beyond their sentimental value, these materials also form an important part of our shared cultural heritage. Over time, however, such items can become fragile and vulnerable to damage, making proper care essential to preserve them for future generations. Join conservator Andrew Huot for an engaging and informative session on how to care for your family treasures. Learn practical and effective methods for preserving, protecting, and safely storing these meaningful items, ensuring they can be enjoyed and appreciated for years to come.
Source: Toronto Public Library — Young Adults

item.title: Branch Art Exhibit: The Fragile Wild — Photographs by Roshan Panjwani — Tue Sep 1, 12:00 AM — Deer Park
item.description: Throughout the month of September, the works of photographer Roshan Panjwani are on display at Deer Park branch . Roshan Panjwani is a Toronto-based nature and wildlife photographer, originally from India. Living with a physical disability has meant approaching fieldwork differently and has reinforced the persistence the work demands. Over more than a decade he has photographed across a wide range of habitats: the tiger reserves of India, the Okavango Delta and salt pans of Botswana, the savannahs of East Africa, the Himalayan high desert of Ladakh, the rainforests of Costa Rica, the mountains and coast of Alaska and the Canadian Rockies, and the High Arctic fjords of Greenland and Svalbard. His photographs have appeared on the cover of Canadian Photography magazine, been featured by BBC Earth, and appear in Europe's Sea Mammals, published by Princeton University Press. Try New Things in Toronto! # 🌅🍂 Sunset Walk: Glen Stewart Ravine & The Beach Boardwalk
### A Short Fall Walk, Ice Cream & Sunset by the Lake
Looking for an easy way to spend a fall evening? Join us for a relaxed **sunset walk through Glen Stewart Ravine**, followed by ice cream and a stroll along the Beach Boardwalk as the sun goes down.
We’ll start at **Main Station** and make our way through the neighbourhood toward Glen Stewart Ravine. After enjoying the ravine and the fall colours, we’ll stop at **Ed’s Real Scoop** for ice cream. 🍦
Then we'll head toward the lake and walk along the **Beach Boardwalk**, taking in the evening light, the water, and the changing colours of the season. We'll finish at **Woodbine Beach**, where we'll take a little time to enjoy the sunset before wrapping up.
This is a **short, easy walk of about 90 minutes**. There’s no rushing and no trying to conquer a trail — just a beautiful evening, something sweet to eat, and good people to enjoy it with.
